mapper.select: SELECT wl.*, CONCAT(u.first_name, ' ', u.last_name) AS user_name, b.title AS book_title FROM waiting_list wl LEFT JOIN Users u ON u.user_id = wl.user_id LEFT JOIN Book b ON b.book_id = wl.book_id WHERE wl.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY wl.join_date DESC

SELECT q.book_id AS bookId, b.title AS bookTitle, q.join_date AS joinDate, q.pos AS position, q.total_waiting AS totalWaiting, b.quantity AS quantity, b.available AS available FROM ( SELECT wl.book_id, wl.user_id, wl.join_date, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY wl.book_id ORDER BY wl.join_date ASC, wl.wait_id ASC) AS pos, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY wl.book_id) AS total_waiting FROM waiting_list wl WHERE wl.status = 'waiting' ) q JOIN Book b ON b.book_id = q.book_id WHERE q.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY q.join_date ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE Waiting_list SET status = 'cancelled' WHERE status = 'waiting' AND join_date < (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - INTERVAL 7 DAY)
UPDATE book b JOIN waiting_list wl ON wl.book_id = b.book_id SET b.quantity = b.quantity + 1, b.available = TRUE WHERE wl.wait_id = #{waitId} AND wl.status = 'notified'
UPDATE waiting_list SET status = 'cancelled', is_notified = 0 WHERE wait_id = #{waitId} AND status IN ('waiting','notified')
